# WALK keeps all paths, TRAIL excludes repeated edges, and ACYCLIC excludes repeated nodes.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-patterns#path_mode
# FinGraph's edges 10 and 13 are parallel, 11 reverses them, and 12 is a self-loop.
# The only two-edge directed walk that repeats an edge is (12, 12).
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH WALK (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person)-[f:Knows]->(c:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "8"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH TRAIL (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person)-[f:Knows]->(c:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "7"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH ACYCLIC (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person)-[f:Knows]->(c:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"

# TRAIL permits self-loops and revisiting nodes, but ACYCLIC excludes both.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH TRAIL (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) WHERE e.id = 12 RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "1"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH ACYCLIC (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) WHERE e.id = 12 RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH TRAIL (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person)-[f:Knows]->(c:Person) WHERE e.id = 10 AND f.id = 11 RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "1"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH TRAIL (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person)-[f:Knows]->(c:Person) WHERE e.id = 12 AND f.id = 12 RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"

# Undirected traversals share edge identity regardless of traversal direction.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH TRAIL (a:Person)-[e:Knows]-(b:Person)-[f:Knows]-(c:Person) WHERE a.id = 2 AND c.id = 2 RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "6"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH ACYCLIC (a:Person)-[e:Knows]-(b:Person)-[f:Knows]-(c:Person) WHERE a.id = 2 AND c.id = 2 RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH TRAIL (a:Person)-[e:Knows]-(b:Person)-[f:Knows]-(c:Person) WHERE e.id = 10 AND f.id = 10 RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH ACYCLIC (a:Person)-[e:Knows]-(b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "6"

# Path variables retain their normal shape after applying a mode.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH p = TRAIL (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person)-[f:Knows]->(c:Person) WHERE e.id = 10 AND f.id = 11 RETURN PATH_LENGTH(p) AS result)
=> "2"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH p = ACYCLIC (a:Person)<-[e:Knows]-(b:Person) WHERE e.id = 10 RETURN PATH_FIRST(p).name AS result)
=> "Dana"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH p = TRAIL (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person)-[f:Knows]->(c:Person) RETURN COUNTIF(NOT IS_TRAIL(p)) AS result)
=> "0"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH p = ACYCLIC (a:Person)-[e:Knows]-(b:Person) RETURN COUNTIF(NOT IS_ACYCLIC(p)) AS result)
=> "0"

# Single-node paths satisfy both modes, including TRAIL's empty edge set.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH TRAIL (a:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH ACYCLIC (a:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH p = TRAIL (a:Person) WHERE a.id = 3 RETURN PATH_LENGTH(p) AS result)
=> "0"

# Identity includes hidden keys, every composite key component, and the element table.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.HiddenKeys MATCH TRAIL (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person)-[f:Knows]->(c:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "7"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.HiddenKeys MATCH ACYCLIC (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.CompoundGraph MATCH ACYCLIC (a:Compound)-[e:CompoundEdge]-(b:Compound) WHERE e.edge_id = 'y' RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "2"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.CompoundGraph MATCH TRAIL (a:Compound)-[e:CompoundEdge]->(b:Compound)-[f:CompoundEdge]->(c:Compound) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "1"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedNodes MATCH ACYCLIC (a:Author)-[e:Knows]-(b:Reader) WHERE e.id = 12 RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "1"

# PATH and PATHS are optional syntax with no semantic effect.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH TRAIL PATH (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "4"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH ACYCLIC PATHS (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"

# GoogleSQL's SIMPLE mode is absent from BigQuery's path-mode grammar.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH SIMPLE (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support
